collector.name: fanqiang-diagnostics
collector.platform: linux OR win32 OR darwin OR other
collector.proxy_note: explicit OS/HTTP proxies are not used; TUN may affect routing

report.problem_category: connectivity OR slow OR dns OR application OR other

sample.status: ok OR error OR timeout OR cancelled

notes: Never upload raw logs, URLs/IPs/node config, hostname, serial IDs, usernames or arbitrary free text. Redacted log preview is LOCAL ONLY and excluded from submitted report.
No automatic submission, no MCP upload tool. Human clicks local preview submit; server acknowledges format not truth/authenticity.
Default throughput OFF; at most 10MiB/15s per run; each local session at most20MiB; abort support; do not count failed/null as0.
Measure sockets use OS route and TUN if enabled, do not claim application-level proxy or ICMP packet loss. Fixed allowlisted HTTPS target, no arbitrary hosts/private DNS addresses/redirects.
MCP stdio via official SDK; CLI web UI users click test/review/submit; persist report and delete receipt locally in private data dir.
Client cross-platform JS no native addon; all dev/build/test Linux. Backend Node24 sqlite built-in only and loopback, nginx /diagnostics-api prefix strips to backend root.
